title: DRdung
description: Plugin for custom dungeons with resources
body:
_Introducing a flexible, user-friendly, and most importantly, FREE dungeon plugin for your Minecraft project - DRdung. The plugin is currently in beta, but it already allows you to customize not only vanilla items with or without enchantments, chances, and quantities, but also enables you to load your own structures and modified items. When adding your own items, the plugin remembers things like:_
**• NBT
• Attribute**

## When spawning a dungeon, a message is displayed that you can edit as you wish:
**• Change the text of the dungeon spawn
• HEX support (Color system 1.16+)**

The plugin ALREADY provides 3 dungeons that are ready to use. The plugin automatically adjusts the dungeons to the landscape and reduces all lags when spawning them to ZERO.

## If necessary, you can customize the generation of dungeons:
**• Add your own structure.
It is also possible to set multiple schemas
• Minimum spawn radius between dungeons
• Maximum spawn radius from the center of the world**

The plugin also includes protection against fake keys, which prevents players from creating their own keys and using them to open dungeons.

To manage dungeons outside of the game, use the plugin's config. To manage dungeons within the game, use the following commands:

```
• /drdung - Opens the dungeon management menu
• /drdung help - Displays a list of valid commands
• /drdung reload - Restarts the plugin
• /drdung spawn - Opens the dungeon spawn menu with spawn settings
• /drdung loot - Opens the loot setting menu
• /drdung key [PLAYER NAME] [NUMBER] - Gives the key (keys) to the player
```


## Dependent parts of the plugin:
**• WorldEdit
• WorldGuard**
